slot_scores.name: unclear_overtime_minimization_goal
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked how to handle the dual objectives of maximizing profit and minimizing overtime. It treated overtime only as a cost to subtract from profit, silently discarding the separate overtime-minimization objective.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Overtime minimization can be handled solely by subtracting overtime cost from profit, rather than as a separate objective or trade-off to clarify.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked how to balance profit maximization and overtime minimization; it assumed a single-objective net-profit formulation without confirmation.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL and finalized the model while the P0 multi-objective overtime-minimization issue remained unresolved.

summary: The agent clarified several useful data and modeling details, but it failed to address the P0 ambiguity between maximizing profit and minimizing overtime, silently collapsing the problem into a single net-profit objective and stopping prematurely.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
